❓ HELP & DOCUMENTATION

⌨ Keyboard Shortcuts

Space Play / Pause transport
Ctrl + Z / Ctrl + Y Undo / Redo last action
Ctrl + S Save project
Ctrl + N / Ctrl + O New / Open project
Ctrl + C / X / V Copy / Cut / Paste selected notes or clips
Delete / Backspace Delete selected notes or clips
Ctrl + Scroll Wheel Zoom timeline horizontally
Ctrl + E Open Export dialog
Ctrl + , Open Preferences
Q (Piano Roll active) Quantize selected notes to grid
L (Piano Roll active) Apply legato — extend notes to fill gaps
Ctrl + K (Piano Roll) Chop notes at the grid boundary

🗂 Arranger View

  • Add a clip: Drag an audio sample from the Browser panel and drop it onto any track lane.
  • Move a clip: Drag it left or right along the timeline. Use Arrow keys for grid-snapped nudging.
  • Resize a clip: Drag the right edge of any clip to shorten or lengthen it.
  • Multi-select clips: Hold Shift and drag to draw a marquee selection over multiple clips.
  • Duplicate a clip: Hold Ctrl and drag a clip to copy it to a new position.
  • Rename a clip: Right-click a clip and choose Rename.
  • Delete a clip: Right-click a clip → Delete, or press Backspace while it is selected.
  • Pattern clips: MIDI notes in the Piano Roll are shown as pattern clips in the arranger. Right-click to rename or slice them.

🎹 Piano Roll

  • Add a note: Left-click on an empty row cell to place a note at that pitch and step position.
  • Delete a note: Right-click on any existing note to remove it immediately.
  • Move a note: Click and drag any note up/down (to change pitch) or left/right (to change timing).
  • Resize a note: Drag the right edge of a note to change its duration.
  • Multi-select: Hold Shift and drag to marquee-select multiple notes. Hold Ctrl and click to add individual notes to selection.
  • Note settings: Right-click a selected note and choose Note Settings to adjust velocity, pan, pitch offset, and probability per note.
  • Snap grid: Use the Snap dropdown at the top of the Piano Roll to set quantization (1/4, 1/8, 1/16, etc.).
  • Quantize: Select notes and press Q to snap them to the current snap grid.
  • Randomize velocity: Use the toolbar button to give all selected notes a slightly randomized velocity for a more human feel.

🥁 Step Sequencer

  • Toggle a step: Left-click a step cell to activate it; click again to deactivate.
  • Delete a step: Right-click an active step to remove it.
  • Pattern length: Use the Steps selector at the top to switch between 8, 16, 32, and 64 step patterns.
  • Assign a sample: Drop any sample from the Browser onto a track header — the track name and step row update instantly.
  • Live triggering: Clicking a step cell while transport is running triggers the sample immediately.

🎚 Tracks & Mixer

  • Add a track: Click the + Add Track button at the bottom of the track list.
  • Rename a track: Click the track name text in the header and type a new name.
  • Move a track: Right-click the track header → Move Up or Move Down.
  • Mute / Solo: Click M or S on any track header or mixer channel.
  • Volume & Pan: Drag the volume knob (right) or pan knob (left) on the track header. Or use the fader in the Mixer view.
  • Automation lane: Click the A button on a track header to reveal the automation lane. Click to place breakpoints, drag to edit. Right-click a breakpoint to delete it.
  • Insert plugins: Open the Mixer view → click any insert slot to add Reverb, Delay, EQ, Compressor or Distortion plugins.
  • Sound Properties: Right-click a track header → Sound Properties to open the generator window (ADSR, Filter, Pitch).

🖥 Transport & LCD

  • Play / Stop: Use the ▶ / ■ transport buttons or press Space.
  • Loop mode: Click the ↻ loop button to enable looped playback between the loop markers.
  • BPM: Click the BPM display and type a new value, or scroll over it to nudge.
  • Position display: Click the position readout in the LCD to toggle between Bars:Beats:Ticks and HH:MM:SS time display.
  • Export: Use File → Export (or Ctrl+E) to render the project to WAV, WebM, or MP3.
